events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Pre-season starts around mid-October. Includes 2-3 social events (get to know each other, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting), and 1-2 adventure rides.

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season from December 1 through May 30. Includes indoor training in January, weekend practices in February, and 2 rides per week March-May. Races start at the beginning of March with typically 5-6 races across North Carolina through the end of May.
